Settings.ThemeHint: Dark is the base. Light changes the substrate under the same palette; the window frame stays dark in both, because the frame is the application and not the sheet.
Settings.DiceSoNiceHint: Off by default — the chat card draws its own dice, and two answers to the same question is worse than either.

Warning.LoadoutFull: Your loadout already holds {max} cards. Send one to the vault first.
Warning.SecondaryBlocked: Your primary weapon is Two-Handed — there is no free hand for a secondary.
Warning.NotYours: That is not your character to spend for.
Warning.AlreadyClaimed: That has already been taken from this roll.
Warning.NoWeapon: The weapon this attack was made with is no longer on the sheet.
Warning.NotEnoughHope: An Experience costs a Hope, and you are short {need}.
Warning.NotEnoughFear: An Experience costs a Fear, and the pool is short {need}.
Warning.NoClass: No class on this character yet — drag one in from the compendium.
Warning.NoUnmarkedTraits: This advancement raises two unmarked traits, and {left} is left unmarked. Marks clear on entering the next tier.
Warning.NotEnoughExperiences: This advancement raises two Experiences, and there are fewer than two to raise. Add them on the adjust tab.
Warning.NoSelection: Select the token or tokens this lands on first.
Warning.NoCharacter: No character is assigned to you — select a token you own, or ask your GM to assign one.
Warning.NoFeatureCost: {name} costs {cost}, and you cannot pay it.
Warning.OtherSubclass: Still holding {names}. That card was not added by character creation, so it has been left alone — remove it by hand if you meant to change subclass.
Warning.OneTransformation: {name} is already {held}, and a character can have only one transformation. Remove that card first if you meant to change it.

Advance.TraitsHint: Choose two unmarked traits. Each gains +1 and is marked until the next tier.
Advance.ExperiencesHint: Choose two Experiences. Each gains a permanent +1.
Advance.GainedExperience: Tier {tier}: gained an Experience at +2 — name it on the adjust tab.

Damage.Title: {name} takes damage
Damage.Rule: One Armor Slot lowers the damage by one threshold.
Damage.BeyondRule: Past one Armor Slot — a card is paying for this.

Rest.Title: {kind}
Rest.Hint: {n} downtime moves. Each applies the moment you take it.

Delete.Title: Delete item
Delete.Body: Delete {name} from this character? This cannot be undone.

Create.Title: Make a character
Create.ChangeClassHint: Becoming a {name} takes these with it. Anything you dragged in yourself is left alone.
